assertions.subject: Soft tissue sarcoma

assertions.subject: Radiation-associated sarcomas

assertions.subject: Soft tissue sarcoma
assertions.quote: Exposure to herbicides such as phenoxyacetic acids and to wood preservatives containing chlorophenols has been linked to an increased risk of soft tissue sarcoma

assertions.subject: Hepatic angiosarcomas
assertions.quote: Several chemical carcinogens, including thorium oxide (Thorotrast), vinyl chloride, and arsenic, have been associated with hepatic angiosarcomas
